name: Articles by year
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pub_year = 2020 RETURN a.pmid, a.title LIMIT 10

name: Citation chain (who cites my citers)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)<-[:CITES]-(b:Article)<-[:CITES]-(c:Article) WHERE a.pmid = '20000334' RETURN b.pmid, c.pmid LIMIT 10

name: MeSH co-occurrence (Neoplasms)
cypher: MATCH (m1:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m2:MeSHTerm) WHERE m1.name = 'Neoplasms' AND m1 <> m2 RETURN m2.name, count(a) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

name: Author collaboration network
cypher: MATCH (au1:Author)<-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au2:Author) WHERE au1.name = 'Arie Hasman' AND au1 <> au2 RETURN au2.name, count(a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Publication trend by year for a MeSH term
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article) WHERE m.name = 'Machine Learning' RETURN a.pub_year, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY a.pub_year DESC LIMIT 20

name: Articles with both MeSH and Chemical annotations
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm {name: 'Machine Learning'})<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article) WITH a LIMIT 100 MATCH (a)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c:Chemical) RETURN a.pmid, c.name LIMIT 10

name: MeSH terms for NIH-funded articles
cypher: MATCH (g:Grant)<-[:FUNDED_BY]-(a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE g.agency = 'NCI NIH HHS' RETURN m.name, count(DISTINCT a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10

name: Multi-MeSH article (articles with 5+ MeSH terms)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WITH a LIMIT 50000 MATCH (a)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WITH a, count(m) AS mesh_count WHERE mesh_count >= 5 RETURN a.pmid, mesh_count ORDER BY mesh_count DESC LIMIT 10

name: Author collaboration (multi-authored articles)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WITH a LIMIT 50000 MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author) WITH a, count(au) AS num_authors WHERE num_authors > 10 RETURN a.pmid, a.title, num_authors ORDER BY num_authors DESC LIMIT 5

name: Chemical → Journal pathway
cypher: MATCH (c:Chemical)<-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]-(a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) WHERE c.name = 'Metformin' RETURN j.title, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10
